services.name: Sunday Shred
services.desc: Join us for our Sunday Shred Sessions, the ultimate mixed group surf club experience! Sunday Shred is the perfect opportunity to meet some new like-minded friends, regardless of your skill level. Each surfer will enjoy a dedicated 20-minute session with as much coaching as you want. --- Number of Riders: Each Sunday Shred session accommodates up to 6 guests. Book individually or bring your friends! Guests for Sunday Shred must be 13 or older. --- What is Included: Professional captain and coach providing instruction tailored to all skill levels Minimum of 20 minutes of riding and Mixed Group Surf Club Experience · Get Out and Shred With Some New Friends! · Ages 13+

services.name: 1 Hour Private Water Sports Charter
services.desc: This one-hour charter is perfect for 1-2 riders to learn wakesurfing, wakeboarding, or water skiing. Each boat holds up to 10 people, so bring your crew and spectators along! Your charter is fully customizable—we can switch between wakesurfing, wakeboarding, water skiing, swimming, and cruising the lake at any time during your booking. Our professional captain and coach, along with quality gear, ensure a memorable adventure. Relax and let us handle the boat, navigation, and logistics while you focus on having fun and progressing your skills with better techniques and new tricks! Wakesurf, Wakeboard, Water Ski or Tube · Starts At $375 Per Group

services.name: Water Sports Camp
services.desc: Get ready for an action-packed summer adventure at our water sports summer camps! Campers ages 8-17 are invited to join us for an exhilarating lineup of wakesurfing, wakeboarding, water skiing, tubing, and swimming. Our camps cater to all experience levels and are tailored to each camper's interests and abilities. Campers will get to choose daily activities, ensuring a fun and personalized experience. They will enjoy professional instruction behind our state-of-the-art MasterCraft boats. Whether they're learning new skills or perfecting their technique, our camps promise to be Summer Memories That Last A Lifetime! · Ages 8 - 17 · 2 Day Camp - 3 Hours Daily
